result.reason: The added clause reaches the fallback by providing a 90-day specifications warranty for supplied Materials, a 30-day professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, and repair, replacement/re-performance, or refund at Ono's election. It does not reach the preferred position because the durations are shorter and it omits compliance-with-laws and malicious-code warranties. The changes are confined to the relevant performance warranty and do not contradict the existing disclaimer, which preserves expressly stated warranties. Drafting quality is reduced because stating that services 'will be performed ... for thirty days following performance' is temporally awkward; the provision should instead state that the warranty applies or claims may be made for 30 days after performance.
